title: SkyrimNet Slave Auction
tagline: A secret slave auction near Riften, voiced by SkyrimNet's AI. Be sold on its stage, or sit among the buyers and bid on whoever is in the cage.
description:
**If you used 0.1.0:** 0.1.0 changed SkyrimNet's settings for other mods' actions. Update and run the separate SkyrimNet Actions Repair once, as the GitHub release page says. If you already ran it with 0.1.1, or started with 0.1.1 or later, you do not need it.

A secret slave auction in a stone basement near Riften. Get sold on its stage, or sit among the buyers and bid on whoever is in the cage: your own followers, or anyone another mod brings in. The staff, the twelve buyers and the captives all speak through SkyrimNet's AI, so no two nights go alike.

**For adult players.** The mod shows captivity and nudity. Children are never caught.

## Be sold yourself
- Drink what the receptionist offers. You wake up naked in a cage, with the followers who were near you.
- The cage guard asks who goes on the stage next. Everyone is auctioned off, one by one.
- The ending depends on what you have installed: an exit mod takes you to its own place, and with none the liberators break in.

## Sell or bid for your followers
- Have your followers take the drink instead, and sit among the buyers.
- Press the bid key to raise your hand. Your character speaks the bid in their own voice, and the buyers answer.
- Win them and they follow you again. Lose them and you get half the price, and can buy them back at 1.5 times the price.

## Build on it
Anyone can add a way in or a way out, with no master on this mod. An entry mod sends one event, and can name who goes on sale or add people to a waiting cage. An exit mod is one JSON file and a marker in your own plugin. A guide for authors comes with the mod.

## Optional samples
- **Entry: Defeated in Battle.** Beaten by humanoid enemies, you are sold instead of dying. Do not use it with another defeat mod.
- **Entry: Abducted in Sleep.** Your followers may be carried off while you sleep.
- **Entry: Sacked Captives.** Needs Diary of Mine. Carry someone to the receptionist's room in a sack, take them out tied up, and hand them over to be sold. You get half of what another buyer pays.
- **Exit: The Mine.** Sold, you work a mine to get out. Followers sold to another buyer can be bought back there.
- **Exit: Carriage to Town.** After the auction, you and the followers you bought arrive at the Riften stables.
- **Exit: Set Free in Debt.** A moneylender wins every lot you do not buy, then sets each free at once, owing three times the price.
- **Add-on: IOU Ledger.** Debts any mod can give an NPC: the debtor carries a bond, and the journal tracks up to ten debtors. Installed with the exit above.

## Requirements
SKSE64, SkyrimNet with an AI model set up, SkyUI, PapyrusUtil and UIExtensions. ZaZ Animation Pack is optional, and needs powerofthree's Papyrus Extender too. The sample Entry: Sacked Captives needs Diary of Mine.

## Known limits
Tested with Nether's Follower Framework only. Tested on Skyrim 1.6.1170 with SkyrimNet beta 29.1. The installer offers English and Japanese.
author: taka
changelog: Other mods can now ask for an auction without the player, naming who goes on sale or adding people to a waiting cage, and each lot goes on as soon as they are sold. New samples: Entry: Sacked Captives (needs Diary of Mine) and Exit: Set Free in Debt, with the new IOU Ledger add-on. Fixed: fights started by the AI in the hall, a freeze while belongings were moved, a follower left behind in the hall, and followers kept in a follower framework slot after being sold. If you ran an auction with 0.1.0 and have not run the SkyrimNet Actions Repair yet, run it once; it is on the GitHub release page.
